title: Affine algebra adjunction counit isomorphism
statement: Let f:X→Y be an affine scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let g be the canonical morphism to the direct image algebra space (Y,f_* O_X) [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and let G=g_* be module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume G is a right adjoint and use its canonical left adjoint and adjunction. Then the canonical adjunction counit is an isomorphism at every quasi-coherent O_X-module. Quasi-coherence is the property of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence].

proof.text: Extract the tensor construction data H, gamma, alpha and beta and invertibility of alpha on quasi-coherent modules from affine_module_correspondence. Retain the second tensor unit formula and the two comparison equations with the scheme tensor pullback adjunction.

The second extension unit gamma is an epimorphism by affine_module_tensor_extension_epi. Scalar restriction S is faithful, since it leaves the underlying component functions unchanged. Use the chosen tensorPullback adjunction T left adjoint to R followed by S. The equation S(beta)=adj.homEquiv(gamma) and gamma_R followed by alpha=counit prove the right triangle after faithful scalar restriction. For the left triangle, cancel gamma, use naturality of gamma to move H(beta) across it, and the same counit equation. The inverse Hom identity gives the left triangle. Thus H is left adjoint to R with counit exactly alpha.

Identify R definitionally with RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage(toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f). Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit to the canonical adjunction and the constructed one. It expresses the canonical counit component as a component of the isomorphism of left adjoints followed by alpha. Both factors are isomorphisms on the given quasi-coherent module, so their composite is an isomorphism.
